v.t: Ha, Meem
v.l: Ha-Mim

v.t: The sending down of the Scripture is from God the Almighty, the Omniscient
v.l: Tanzilu Al-Kitabi Mina Allahi Al-`Azizi Al-`Alimi

v.t: Forgiver of sins, Accepter of repentance, Severe in punishment, Bountiful in bounty. There is no god but He. To Him is the ultimate return
v.l: Ghafiri Adh-Dhanbi Wa Qabili At-Tawbi Shadidi Al-`Iqabi Dhi At-Tawli La 'Ilaha 'Illa Huwa 'Ilayhi Al-Masiru

v.t: None argues against God’s revelations except those who disbelieve. So do not be impressed by their activities in the land
v.l: Ma Yujadilu Fi 'Ayati Allahi 'Illa Al-Ladhina Kafaru Fala Yaghrurka Taqallubuhum Fi Al-Biladi

v.t: Before them the people of Noah rejected the truth, as did the confederates after them. Every community plotted against their messenger, to capture him. And they argued with falsehood, to defeat with it the truth. But I seized them. What a punishment it was
v.l: Kadhabat Qablahum Qawmu Nuhin Wa Al-'Ahzabu Min Ba`dihim Wa Hammat Kullu 'Ummatin Birasulihim Liya'khudhuhu Wa Jadalu Bil-Batili Liyudhiđu Bihi Al-Haqqa Fa'akhadhtuhum Fakayfa Kana `Iqabi

v.t: Thus the sentence of your Lord became realized against those who disbelieve, that they are to be inmates of the Fire
v.l: Wa Kadhalika Haqqat Kalimatu Rabbika `Ala Al-Ladhina Kafaru 'Annahum 'Ashabu An-Nari

v.t: Those who carry the Throne, and those around it, glorify their Lord with praise, and believe in Him, and ask for forgiveness for those who believe: “Our Lord, You have encompassed everything in mercy and knowledge; so forgive those who repent and follow Your path, and protect them from the agony of the Blaze
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yahmiluna Al-`Arsha Wa Man Hawlahu Yusabbihuna Bihamdi Rabbihim Wa Yu'uminuna Bihi Wa Yastaghfiruna Lilladhina 'Amanu Rabbana Wasi`ta Kulla Shay'in Rahmatan Wa `Ilmaan Faghfir Lilladhina Tabu Wa Attaba`u Sabilaka Wa Qihim `Adhaba Al-Jahimi

v.t: And admit them, Our Lord, into the Gardens of Eternity, which You have promised them, and the righteous among their parents, and their spouses, and their offspring. You are indeed the Almighty, the Most Wise
v.l: Rabbana Wa 'Adkhilhum Jannati `Adnin Allati Wa`adtahum Wa Man Salaha Min 'Aba'ihim Wa 'Azwajihim Wa Dhurriyatihim 'Innaka 'Anta Al-`Azizu Al-Hakimu

v.t: And shield them from the evil deeds. Whomever You shield from the evil deeds, on that Day, You have had mercy on him. That is the supreme achievement.”
v.l: Wa Qihimu As-Sayyi'ati Wa Man Taqi As-Sayyi'ati Yawma'idhin Faqad Rahimtahu Wa Dhalika Huwa Al-Fawzu Al-`Azimu
w: You have bestowed mercy on him

v.t: Those who disbelieved will be addressed, “The loathing of God is greater than your loathing of yourselves—for you were invited to the faith, but you refused.”
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Kafaru Yunadawna Lamaqtu Allahi 'Akbaru Min Maqtikum 'Anfusakum 'Idh Tud`awna 'Ila Al-'Imani Fatakfuruna
w: will be cried out to them

v.t: They will say, “Our Lord, you made us die twice, and twice you gave us life. Now we acknowledge our sins. Is there any way out?”
v.l: Qalu Rabbana 'Amattana Athnatayni Wa 'Ahyaytana Athnatayni Fa`tarafna Bidhunubina Fahal 'Ila Khurujin Min Sabilin

v.t: That is because when God alone was called upon, you disbelieved; but when others were associated with Him, you believed. Judgment rests with God the Sublime, the Majestic
v.l: Dhalikum Bi'annahu 'Idha Du`iya Allahu Wahdahu Kafartum Wa 'In Yushrak Bihi Tu'uminu Falhukmu Lillahi Al-`Aliyi Al-Kabiri

v.t: It is He who shows you His wonders, and sends down sustenance from the sky for you. But none pays heed except the repentant
v.l: Huwa Al-Ladhi Yurikum 'Ayatihi Wa Yunazzilu Lakum Mina As-Sama'i Rizqaan Wa Ma Yatadhakkaru 'Illa Man Yunibu

v.t: So call upon God, with sincere devotion to Him, even though the disbelievers resent it
v.l: Fad`u Allaha Mukhlisina Lahu Ad-Dina Wa Law Kariha Al-Kafiruna

v.t: Exalted in rank, Owner of the Throne. He conveys the Spirit, by His command, upon whomever He wills of His servants, to warn of the Day of Encounter
v.l: Rafi`u Ad-Darajati Dhu Al-`Arshi Yulqi Ar-Ruha Min 'Amrihi `Ala Man Yasha'u Min `Ibadihi Liyundhira Yawma At-Talaqi

v.t: The Day when they will emerge, nothing about them will be concealed from God. “To whom does the sovereignty belong today?” “To God, the One, the Irresistible.”
v.l: Yawma Hum Barizuna La Yakhfa `Ala Allahi Minhum Shay'un Limani Al-Mulku Al-Yawma Lillahi Al-Wahidi Al-Qahhari

v.t: On that Day, every soul will be recompensed for what it had earned. There will be no injustice on that Day. God is quick to settle accounts
v.l: Al-Yawma Tujza Kullu Nafsin Bima Kasabat La Zulma Al-Yawma 'Inna Allaha Sari`u Al-Hisabi

v.t: And warn them of the Day of Imminence, when the hearts are at the throats, choking them. The evildoers will have no intimate friend, and no intercessor to be obeyed
v.l: Wa 'Andhirhum Yawma Al-'Azifati 'Idhi Al-Qulubu Lada Al-Hanajiri Kazimina Ma Lilzzalimina Min Hamimin Wa La Shafi`in Yuta`u

v.t: He knows the deceptions of the eyes, and what the hearts conceal
v.l: Ya`lamu Kha'inata Al-'A`yuni Wa Ma Tukhfi As-Suduru

v.t: God judges with justice, while those whom they invoke besides Him cannot judge with anything. It is God who is the Hearing, the Seeing
v.l: Wa Allahu Yaqđi Bil-Haqqi Wa Al-Ladhina Yad`una Min Dunihi La Yaqđuna Bishay'in 'Inna Allaha Huwa As-Sami`u Al-Basiru

v.t: Have they not travelled through the earth, and seen the consequences for those before them? They were stronger than them, and they left more impact on earth. But God seized them for their sins, and they had no defender against God
v.l: Awa Lam Yasiru Fi Al-'Arđi Fayanzuru Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Ladhina Kanu Min Qablihim Kanu Hum 'Ashadda Minhum Quwatan Wa 'Atharaan Fi Al-'Arđi Fa'akhadhahumu Allahu Bidhunubihim Wa Ma Kana Lahum Mini Allahi Min Waqin

v.t: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so God seized them. He is Strong, Severe in retribution
v.l: Dhalika Bi'annahum Kanat Ta'tihim Rusuluhum Bil-Bayyinati Fakafaru Fa'akhadhahumu Allahu 'Innahu Qawiyun Shadidu Al-`Iqabi

v.t: We sent Moses with Our signs, and a clear authority
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna Musa Bi'ayatina Wa Sultanin Mubinin

v.t: To Pharaoh, Hamaan, and Quaroon. But they said, “A lying sorcerer.”
v.l: Ila Fir`awna Wa Hamana Wa Qaruna Faqalu Sahirun Kadhabun

v.t: Then, when he came to them with the truth from Us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who have believed with him, and spare their daughters.” But the scheming of the unbelievers can only go astray
v.l: Falamma Ja'ahum Bil-Haqqi Min `Indina Qalu Aqtulu 'Abna'a Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Ma`ahu Wa Astahyu Nisa'ahum Wa Ma Kaydu Al-Kafirina 'Illa Fi Đalalin

v.t: Pharaoh said, “Leave me to kill Moses, and let him appeal to his Lord. I fear he may change your religion, or spread disorder in the land.”
v.l: Wa Qala Fir`awnu Dharuni 'Aqtul Musa Wa Liad`u Rabbahu 'Inni 'Akhafu 'An Yubaddila Dinakum 'Aw 'An Yuzhira Fi Al-'Arđi Al-Fasada

v.t: Moses said, “I have sought the protection of my Lord and your Lord, from every tyrant who does not believe in the Day of Account.”
v.l: Wa Qala Musa 'Inni `Udhtu Birabbi Wa Rabbikum Min Kulli Mutakabbirin La Yu'uminu Biyawmi Al-Hisabi

v.t: A believing man from Pharaoh's family, who had concealed his faith, said, “Are you going to kill a man for saying, `My Lord is God,’ and he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? If he is a liar, his lying will rebound upon him; but if he is truthful, then some of what he promises you will befall you. God does not guide the extravagant imposter
v.l: Wa Qala Rajulun Mu'uminun Min 'Ali Fir`awna Yaktumu 'Imanahu 'Ataqtuluna Rajulaan 'An Yaqula Rabbiya Allahu Wa Qad Ja'akum Bil-Bayyinati Min Rabbikum Wa 'In Yaku Kadhibaan Fa`alayhi Kadhibuhu Wa 'In Yaku Sadiqaan Yusibkum Ba`đu Al-Ladhi Ya`idukum 'Inna Allaha La Yahdi Man Huwa Musrifun Kadhabun

v.t: O my people! Yours is the dominion today, supreme in the land; but who will help us against God’s might, should it fall upon us?” Pharaoh said, “I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the path of prudence.”
v.l: Ya Qawmi Lakumu Al-Mulku Al-Yawma Zahirina Fi Al-'Arđi Faman Yansuruna Min Ba'si Allahi 'In Ja'ana Qala Fir`awnu Ma 'Urikum 'Illa Ma 'Ara Wa Ma 'Ahdikum 'Illa Sabila Ar-Rashadi

v.t: The one who had believed said, “O my people, I fear for you the like of the day of the confederates
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhi 'Amana Ya Qawmi 'Inni 'Akhafu `Alaykum Mithla Yawmi Al-'Ahzabi

v.t: Like the fate of the people of Noah, and Aad, and Thamood, and those after them. God wants no injustice for the servants
v.l: Mithla Da'bi Qawmi Nuhin Wa `Adin Wa Thamuda Wa Al-Ladhina Min Ba`dihim Wa Ma Allahu Yuridu Zulmaan Lil`ibadi

v.t: O my people, I fear for you the Day of Calling Out
v.l: Wa Yaqawmi 'Inni 'Akhafu `Alaykum Yawma At-Tanadi

v.t: The Day when you will turn and flee, having no defender against God. Whomever God misguides has no guide.”
v.l: Yawma Tuwalluna Mudbirina Ma Lakum Mina Allahi Min `Asimin Wa Man Yuđlili Allahu Fama Lahu Min Hadin

v.t: Joseph had come to you with clear revelations, but you continued to doubt what he came to you with. Until, when he perished, you said, “God will never send a messenger after him.” Thus God leads astray the outrageous skeptic
v.l: Wa Laqad Ja'akum Yusufu Min Qablu Bil-Bayyinati Fama Ziltum Fi Shakkin Mimma Ja'akum Bihi Hatta 'Idha Halaka Qultum Lan Yab`atha Allahu Min Ba`dihi Rasulaan Kadhalika Yuđillu Allahu Man Huwa Musrifun Murtabun

v.t: Those who argue against God’s revelations, without any proof having come to them—a heinous sin in the sight of God, and of those who believe. Thus God seals the heart of every proud bully
v.l: Al-Ladhina Yujadiluna Fi 'Ayati Allahi Bighayri Sultanin 'Atahum Kabura Maqtaan `Inda Allahi Wa `Inda Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Kadhalika Yatba`u Allahu `Ala Kulli Qalbi Mutakabbirin Jabbarin

v.t: And Pharaoh said, “O Hamaan, build me a tower, that I may reach the pathways
v.l: Wa Qala Fir`awnu Ya Hamanu Abni Li Sarhaan La`alli 'Ablughu Al-'Asbaba

v.t: The pathways of the heavens, so that I may glance at the God of Moses; though I think he is lying.” Thus Pharaoh’s evil deeds were made to appear good to him, and he was averted from the path. Pharaoh's guile was only in defeat
v.l: Asbaba As-Samawati Fa'attali`a 'Ila 'Ilahi Musa Wa 'Inni La'azunnuhu Kadhibaan Wa Kadhalika Zuyyina Lifir`awna Su'u `Amalihi Wa Sudda `Ani As-Sabili Wa Ma Kaydu Fir`awna 'Illa Fi Tababin

v.t: The one who had believed said, “O my people, follow me, and I will guide you to the path of rectitude.”
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhi 'Amana Ya Qawmi Attabi`uni 'Ahdikum Sabila Ar-Rashadi

v.t: “O my people, the life of this world is nothing but fleeting enjoyment, but the Hereafter is the Home of Permanence
v.l: Ya Qawmi 'Innama Hadhihi Al-Haya Atu Ad-Dunya Mata`un Wa 'Inna Al-'Akhirata Hiya Daru Al-Qarari

v.t: Whoever commits a sin will be repaid only with its like. But whoever works righteousness, whether male or female, and is a believer—these will enter Paradise, where they will be provided for without account
v.l: Man `Amila Sayyi'atan Fala Yujza 'Illa Mithlaha Wa Man `Amila Salihaan Min Dhakarin 'Aw 'Untha Wa Huwa Mu'uminun Fa'ula'ika Yadkhuluna Al-Jannata Yurzaquna Fiha Bighayri Hisabin

v.t: O my people, how is it that I call you to salvation, and you call me to the Fire
v.l: Wa Yaqawmi Ma Li 'Ad`ukum 'Ila An-Najaati Wa Tad`unani 'Ila An-Nari

v.t: You call me to reject God, and to associate with Him what I have no knowledge of, while I call you to the Mighty Forgiver
v.l: Tad`unani Li'kfura Billahi Wa 'Ushrika Bihi Ma Laysa Li Bihi `Ilmun Wa 'Ana 'Ad`ukum 'Ila Al-`Azizi Al-Ghaffari

v.t: Without a doubt, what you call me to has no say in this world, or in the Hereafter; and our turning back is to God; and the transgressors are the inmates of the Fire
v.l: La Jarama 'Annama Tad`unani 'Ilayhi Laysa Lahu Da`watun Fi Ad-Dunya Wa La Fi Al-'Akhirati Wa 'Anna Maraddana 'Ila Allahi Wa 'Anna Al-Musrifina Hum 'Ashabu An-Nari

v.t: You will remember what I am telling you, so I commit my case to God. God is Observant of the servants.”
v.l: Fasatadhkuruna Ma 'Aqulu Lakum Wa 'Ufawwiđu 'Amri 'Ila Allahi 'Inna Allaha Basirun Bil-`Ibadi

v.t: So God protected him from the evils of their scheming, while a terrible torment besieged Pharaoh’s clan
v.l: Fawaqahu Allahu Sayyi'ati Ma Makaru Wa Haqa Bi'ali Fir`awna Su'u Al-`Adhabi

v.t: The Fire. They will be exposed to it morning and evening. And on the Day the Hour takes place: “Admit the clan of Pharaoh to the most intense agony.”
v.l: An-Naru Yu`rađuna `Alayha Ghuduwaan Wa `Ashiyaan Wa Yawma Taqumu As-Sa`atu 'Adkhilu 'Ala Fir`awna 'Ashadda Al-`Adhabi

v.t: As they quarrel in the Fire, the weak will say to those who were arrogant, “We were followers of yours; will you then spare us a portion of the Fire?”
v.l: Wa 'Idh Yatahajjuna Fi An-Nari Fayaqulu Ađ-Đu`afa'u Lilladhina Astakbaru 'Inna Kunna Lakum Taba`aan Fahal 'Antum Mughnuna `Anna Nasibaan Mina An-Nari

v.t: Those who were arrogant will say, “We are all in it; God has judged between the servants.”
v.l: Qala Al-Ladhina Astakbaru 'Inna Kullun Fiha 'Inna Allaha Qad Hakama Bayna Al-`Ibadi

v.t: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, “Call to your Lord to lessen our suffering for one day.”
v.l: Wa Qala Al-Ladhina Fi An-Nari Likhazanati Jahannama Ad`u Rabbakum Yukhaffif `Anna Yawmaan Mina Al-`Adhabi

v.t: They will say, “Did not your messengers come to you with clear signs?” They will say, “Yes.” They will say, “Then pray, but the prayers of the disbelievers will always be in vain.”
v.l: Qalu 'Awa Lam Taku Ta'tikum Rusulukum Bil-Bayyinati Qalu Bala Qalu Fad`u Wa Ma Du`a'u Al-Kafirina 'Illa Fi Đalalin

v.t: Most surely We will support Our messengers and those who believe, in this life, and on the Day the witnesses arise
v.l: Inna Lanansuru Rusulana Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Fi Al-Hayaati Ad-Dunya Wa Yawma Yaqumu Al-'Ash/hadu

v.t: The Day when their excuses will not profit the wrongdoers, and the curse will be upon them, and they will have the Home of Misery
v.l: Yawma La Yanfa`u Az-Zalimina Ma`dhiratuhum Wa Lahumu Al-La`natu Wa Lahum Su'u Ad-Dari

v.t: We gave Moses guidance, and made the Children of Israel inherit the Scripture
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Atayna Musa Al-Huda Wa 'Awrathna Bani 'Isra'ila Al-Kitaba

v.t: A guide and a reminder for those endowed with reason
v.l: Hudaan Wa Dhikra Li'wli Al-'Albabi

v.t: So be patient. The promise of God is true. And ask forgiveness for your sin, and proclaim the praise of your Lord evening and morning
v.l: Fasbir 'Inna Wa`da Allahi Haqqun Wa Astaghfir Lidhanbika Wa Sabbih Bihamdi Rabbika Bil-`Ashiyi Wa Al-'Ibkari

v.t: Those who dispute regarding God’s revelations without any authority having come to them—there is nothing in their hearts but the feeling of greatness, which they will never attain. So seek refuge in God; for He is the All-Hearing, the All-Seeing
v.l: Inna Al-Ladhina Yujadiluna Fi 'Ayati Allahi Bighayri Sultanin 'Atahum 'In Fi Sudurihim 'Illa Kibrun Ma Hum Bibalighihi Fasta`idh Billahi 'Innahu Huwa As-Sami`u Al-Basiru

v.t: Certainly the creation of the heavens and the earth is greater than the creation of humanity, but most people do not know
v.l: Lakhalqu As-Samawati Wa Al-'Arđi 'Akbaru Min Khalqi An-Nasi Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Ya`lamuna

v.t: Not equal are the blind and the seeing. Nor are those who believe and work righteousness equal to the sinners. How little you reflect
v.l: Wa Ma Yastawi Al-'A`ma Wa Al-Basiru Wa Al-Ladhina 'Amanu Wa `Amilu As-Salihati Wa La Al-Musi'u Qalilaan Ma Tatadhakkaruna

v.t: Indeed, the Hour is coming; there is no doubt about it; but most people do not believe
v.l: Inna As-Sa`ata La'atiyatun La Rayba Fiha Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Yu'uminuna

v.t: Your Lord has said, “Pray to Me, and I will respond to you. But those who are too proud to worship Me will enter Hell forcibly.”
v.l: Wa Qala Rabbukum Ad`uni 'Astajib Lakum 'Inna Al-Ladhina Yastakbiruna `An `Ibadati Sayadkhuluna Jahannama Dakhirina

v.t: It is God Who made the night for you, that you may rest therein; and the day allowing sight. God is gracious towards the people, but most people do not give thanks
v.l: Allahu Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Lakumu Al-Layla Litaskunu Fihi Wa An-Nahara Mubsiraan 'Inna Allaha Ladhu Fađlin `Ala An-Nasi Wa Lakinna 'Akthara An-Nasi La Yashkuruna

v.t: Such is God, your Lord, Creator of all things. There is no god except Him; so how could you turn away
v.l: Dhalikumu Allahu Rabbukum Khaliqu Kulli Shay'in La 'Ilaha 'Illa Huwa Fa'anna Tu'ufakuna

v.t: Thus are turned away those who dispute the signs of God
v.l: Kadhalika Yu'ufaku Al-Ladhina Kanu Bi'ayati Allahi Yajhaduna

v.t: It is God who made the earth a habitat for you, and the sky a structure. And He designed you, and designed you well; and He provided you with the good things. Such is God, your Lord; so Blessed is God, Lord of the Worlds
v.l: Allahu Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Lakumu Al-'Arđa Qararaan Wa As-Sama'a Bina'an Wa Sawwarakum Fa'ahsana Suwarakum Wa Razaqakum Mina At-Tayyibati Dhalikumu Allahu Rabbukum Fatabaraka Allahu Rabbu Al-`Alamina

v.t: He is the Living One. There is no god except He. So pray to Him, devoting your religion to Him. Praise be to God, the Lord of the Worlds
v.l: Huwa Al-Hayyu La 'Ilaha 'Illa Huwa Fad`uhu Mukhlisina Lahu Ad-Dina Al-Hamdu Lillahi Rabbi Al-`Alamina

v.t: Say, “I was prohibited from worshiping those you invoke besides God, now that clear revelations have come to me from my Lord; and I was commanded to submit to the Lord of the Worlds.”
v.l: Qul 'Inni Nuhitu 'An 'A`buda Al-Ladhina Tad`una Min Duni Allahi Lamma Ja'aniya Al-Bayyinatu Min Rabbi Wa 'Umirtu 'An 'Uslima Lirabbi Al-`Alamina

v.t: It is He who created you from dust, then from a seed, then from an embryo, then He brings you out as an infant, then He lets you reach your maturity, then you become elderly—although some of you die sooner—so that you may reach a predetermined age, so that you may understand
v.l: Huwa Al-Ladhi Khalaqakum Min Turabin Thumma Min Nutfatin Thumma Min `Alaqatin Thumma Yukhrijukum Tiflaan Thumma Litablughu 'Ashuddakum Thumma Litakunu Shuyukhaan Wa Minkum Man Yutawaffa Min Qablu Wa Litablughu 'Ajalaan Musammaan Wa La`allakum Ta`qiluna

v.t: It is He who gives life and death; and when He decides on a thing, He just says to it, “Be,” and it comes to be
v.l: Huwa Al-Ladhi Yuhyi Wa Yumitu Fa'idha Qađa 'Amraan Fa'innama Yaqulu Lahu Kun Fayakunu

v.t: Have you not observed those who dispute regarding God's revelations, how they have deviated
v.l: Alam Tara 'Ila Al-Ladhina Yujadiluna Fi 'Ayati Allahi 'Anna Yusrafuna

v.t: Those who call the Book a lie, and what We sent Our messengers with—they will surely know
v.l: Al-Ladhina Kadhabu Bil-Kitabi Wa Bima 'Arsalna Bihi Rusulana Fasawfa Ya`lamuna

v.t: When the yokes are around their necks, and they will be dragged by the chains
v.l: Idhi Al-'Aghlalu Fi 'A`naqihim Wa As-Salasilu Yushabuna

v.t: Into the boiling water, then in the Fire they will be consumed
v.l: Fi Al-Hamimi Thumma Fi An-Nari Yusjaruna

v.t: Then it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to deify
v.l: Thumma Qila Lahum 'Ayna Ma Kuntum Tushrikuna

v.t: Instead of God?” They will say, “They have abandoned us. In fact, we were praying to nothing before.” Thus God sends the disbelievers astray
v.l: Min Duni Allahi Qalu Đallu `Anna Bal Lam Nakun Nad`u Min Qablu Shay'aan Kadhalika Yuđillu Allahu Al-Kafirina

v.t: That is because you used to rejoice on earth in other than the truth, and because you used to behave with vanity
v.l: Dhalikum Bima Kuntum Tafrahuna Fi Al-'Arđi Bighayri Al-Haqqi Wa Bima Kuntum Tamrahuna

v.t: Enter the gates of Hell, to remain therein forever. What a terrible dwelling for the arrogant
v.l: Adkhulu 'Abwaba Jahannama Khalidina Fiha Fabi'sa Mathwa Al-Mutakabbirina

v.t: So be patient. The promise of God is true. Whether We show you some of what We have promised them, or take you to Us, to Us they will be returned
v.l: Fasbir 'Inna Wa`da Allahi Haqqun Fa'imma Nuriyannaka Ba`đa Al-Ladhi Na`iduhum 'Aw Natawaffayannaka Fa'ilayna Yurja`una

v.t: We sent messengers before you. Some of them We told you about, and some We did not tell you about. No messenger can bring a miracle except by leave of God. Then, when the command of God is issued, fair judgment will be passed, and there and then the seekers of vanity will lose
v.l: Wa Laqad 'Arsalna Rusulaan Min Qablika Minhum Man Qasasna `Alayka Wa Minhum Man Lam Naqsus `Alayka Wa Ma Kana Lirasulin 'An Ya'tiya Bi'ayatin 'Illa Bi'idhni Allahi Fa'idha Ja'a 'Amru Allahi Quđiya Bil-Haqqi Wa Khasira Hunalika Al-Mubtiluna

v.t: God is He who created the domestic animals for you—some for you to ride, and some you eat
v.l: Allahu Al-Ladhi Ja`ala Lakumu Al-'An`am Litarkabu Minha Wa Minha Ta'kuluna

v.t: And in them you have other benefits as well, and through them you satisfy your needs. And on them, and on the ships, you are transported
v.l: Wa Lakum Fiha Manafi`u Wa Litablughu `Alayha Hajatan Fi Sudurikum Wa `Alayha Wa `Ala Al-Fulki Tuhmaluna

v.t: And He shows you His signs. So which of God’s signs will you deny
v.l: Wa Yurikum 'Ayatihi Fa'ayya 'Ayati Allahi Tunkiruna

v.t: Have they not journeyed through the land, and seen the outcome for those before them? They were more numerous than they, and had greater power and influence in the land. But what they had achieved availed them nothing
v.l: Afalam Yasiru Fi Al-'Arđi Fayanzuru Kayfa Kana `Aqibatu Al-Ladhina Min Qablihim Kanu 'Akthara Minhum Wa 'Ashadda Quwatan Wa 'Atharaan Fi Al-'Arđi Fama 'Aghna `Anhum Ma Kanu Yaksibuna

v.t: When their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they rejoiced in the knowledge they had, and the very things they used to ridicule besieged them
v.l: Falamma Ja'at/hum Rusuluhum Bil-Bayyinati Farihu Bima `Indahum Mina Al-`Ilmi Wa Haqa Bihim Ma Kanu Bihi Yastahzi'un

v.t: Then, when they witnessed Our might, they said, “We believe in God alone, and we reject what we used to associate with Him.”
v.l: Falamma Ra'aw Ba'sana Qalu 'Amanna Billahi Wahdahu Wa Kafarna Bima Kunna Bihi Mushrikina

v.t: But their faith could not help them once they witnessed Our might. This has been God’s way of dealing with His servants. And there and then the disbelievers lost
v.l: Falam Yaku Yanfa`uhum 'Imanuhum Lamma Ra'aw Ba'sana Sunnata Allahi Allati Qad Khalat Fi `Ibadihi Wa Khasira Hunalika Al-Kafiruna
